test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 15 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All actors are singers.

All singers are dancers.

Conclusions:

(I) At least some singers are actors.

(II) Some dancers may not be singers.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/008072093c07aaf18b3dde1f81ead13f2efea77adce6435be2ed703116eb3bbc.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) At least some singers are actors → Follow (As all actors are singers and all singers are dancers. As whole actors comes in singers, therefore it is false.)

(II) Some dancers may not be singers → Follow (As all singers are dancers. As whole actors comes in singers which whole comes in dancers, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, **Both I and II follow.**​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2"
